text_block_list.text:
A few days after the race, Chairwoman 
Akikawa paid a visit—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Blessings! That previous race was 
magnificent. My eyes did not deceive me 
after all!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
An appointment! I want you, along with 
Special Week and the others, to give a 
talk at the kids' racing club!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the lecture format up to you. 
As one of our star Umamusume, I want you 
to deliver your message to your heart's 
content!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's a big responsibility! I'll do my 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited! There are so many amazing 
upperclassmen! I wonder what kind of 
lectures they'll give?
choice_data_list:
Craft, have you come up with what to say 
for the lecture yet?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure it's something that leads 
to a bright future for the children! Fufu, 
please look forward to it!

On the day of the lecture, the Umamusume 
who had achieved glorious success took to 
the stage one after another to speak to 
the children—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today! I came to share the excitement with 
everyone! Running alongside my greatest 
rival on the stage of our dreams—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U... Waaaahhhhh! Let's watch the greatest 
Derby footage togetherrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Letting your feelings of admiration swell. 
How wonderful! That sounds so like you, 
Ticket-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, has everyone received their handout?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... "Very clean start ◎ Runs willingly 
even on rainy days ◎"...! This is about 
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was able to look at everyone's races and 
training sessions in advance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"My report card for you—it represents high 
expectations. Please, let it be a source 
of strength for you."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! Running with everyone's expectations as 
a tailwind. That's an announcement so 
uniquely McQueen-san...!
choice_data_list: It's Craft's turn next, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...Alright, me too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Does everyone have a dream? A big dream 
you're determined to make come true.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Today! I'm gonna teach you a way to get 
strong enough to make that come true~!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh—!? Really!? —I totally do~~! I wanna 
know!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well then, first off... everyone, let's 
run!!!

Rhein Kraft and the others burst forward 
with great momentum. However, as they 
neared the goal—

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa...! —...Ugh... *pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo... Alright, I can see the final 
straight! This is where it counts, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Shout out your dream!!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: !! *pant* *pant*... W-Was that a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“My dream is... just as you showed me the 
path on that day—”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Leave proof of our run for the future!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna be just like Spe-chan!! —I will 
definitely win the Tiaraaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... I did it, I did it...! I 
finished a lap, for the first time... all 
the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes. Dreams, and words, become strength.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Forward, ever forward. I'll connect your 
legs to your dreams—and to the future!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: !! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: "Craft-senseeei! Teach us more stuff!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: T-Teacher...!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because it was amazing! Fast, 
strong, and so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, ...Ehehe! Jeez, not you too, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now then, what should I teach 
you first?
choice_data_list: Stuff about my rivals and all!
How about talking about a memorable race?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now then, what should I teach 
you first?
choice_data_list: Stuff about my rivals and all!
How about talking about a memorable race?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Then first, about the 
greatness of the Tiara... No, wait, should 
we start with Sweep-san...?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Every single thing!! I wanna hear it 
aall!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Got it! Ummm, well... when I first 
fell in love with racing, I was around the 
same age as all of you—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! Cesario, Messiah-san, 
Heart-san, and also—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if we talk about everyone, the sun's 
gonna go down...!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! I wanna hear it~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's alright. I'll come again. And 
we can take our time catching up!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Every single one is so 
memorable. Because I gave it my absolute 
all in every race!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So everyone, here is a request from your 
teacher! Whether it's a big race or a 
small race, run each and every one with 
care!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!!
